checks.name: Delivery updates do not create history records; invoices, attempts and recovery increase storage.
Closing returns four settlement tokens but retains order state and does not refund the native deposit.
A 1.25-NEAR creation deposit keeps the extra 0.25 NEAR instead of returning it.
Maximum-sized fields, 32 invoices, 64 payment records and eight retained refund records fit within the current deposit with a 25% comparison margin.
Retirement test guard rejects an open order and a real transfer with a failed callback.
Disposable full-access owner removed code, blocked new calls and deleted the settled account; the explicit beneficiary received the remaining native balance.

limitations: Sandbox measurements are not mainnet transaction quotes or an exhaustive state-space proof.
Outcome tokens_burnt is reported separately from deposits and contract gas rewards.
A 25% comparison margin is an analysis assumption, not a newly approved order deposit.
The retirement guard is an offchain test helper. The deployed vault has no atomic pause, customer cleanup or native-deposit refund API.
Disposable full-access-key teardown does not establish a safe production shutdown or depositor allocation policy.

excessDeposit.note: Vault increase includes a small gas reward; no native depositor ledger exists.

maxObserved.note: Observed bound exercise, not an exhaustive proof of all failure interleavings or a new deposit policy.

disposableRetirement.conditions: All orders Closed, accepted goods paid, pending/refund-pending zero, token funding reconciled and vault token balance zero; all actors controlled by this isolated harness.
disposableRetirement.beneficiary: Explicit test beneficiary, not an automatic distribution to original depositors.
